description: email.rs extract_header_values (line ~313): uses 'return if req.all { Value::Array(vec\![]) } else { Value::Null }' inside a None branch — the 'return' is unnecessary and Clippy's needless_return lint would flag it. The correct form is just 'if req.all { … } else { … }' as the last expression in the branch. Also, the entire 'match headers { None => return …; Some(h) => h }' could be written as 'let Some(headers) = … else { return if req.all … }' using let-else. Minor but representative.
title: if req.all { return … } else { return … } — unnecessary explicit return
